cases.input: Who are my contacts in the workspace?
cases.expected_output: Here are the contacts in your workspace. [List of contacts from the workspace directory]
retrieval_context: The workspace has a contacts directory with team members and external collaborators.

cases.input: What meetings do I have this week?
cases.expected_output: You have the following meetings this week. [Calendar events listed by date and time]
retrieval_context: Calendar contains scheduled meetings, events, and tasks for the current week.

cases.input: Search for wiki pages about onboarding
cases.expected_output: I found the following wiki pages related to onboarding. [List of matching wiki pages with titles and summaries]
retrieval_context: The wiki contains documentation pages organized by topic including onboarding guides.

cases.input: Show me recent messages from the general channel
cases.expected_output: Here are the recent messages from the general conversation. [List of recent messages with sender and content]
retrieval_context: The workspace has chat conversations including a general channel for team-wide communication.

cases.input: Find emails about the project deadline
cases.expected_output: I found the following email threads mentioning project deadline. [Email threads with subject and snippet]
retrieval_context: Mail threads are searchable by keyword across all connected mail accounts.

cases.input: Who is the owner of serenity project?
cases.expected_output: The owner of the serenity project is listed as Alex Vance in the project settings.
retrieval_context: Project settings and workspace configuration identify Alex Vance as the lead owner of Serenity.

cases.input: What is the email address of David?
cases.expected_output: David's email address is david.miller@workspace.com.
retrieval_context: The workspace user directory lists David Miller with email david.miller@workspace.com.

cases.input: Find any messages mentioning key results
cases.expected_output: Here are the messages mentioning key results: [List of chat history snippets containing 'key results']
retrieval_context: Chat history indexes search queries for key phrases like 'key results' or 'OKRs'.

cases.input: Summarize the latest meeting about sprint planning
cases.expected_output: In the latest sprint planning meeting, the team agreed to focus on the evaluation module and set the release date to Friday.
retrieval_context: Meeting transcript: Discussed evaluation module, assigned task to Huy, target deadline set to Friday.

cases.input: Show me all team members in the Engineering department
cases.expected_output: Here are the members of the Engineering team: Huy (Lead), David (Senior Dev), and Mary (QA).
retrieval_context: The departments directory lists Engineering team members: Huy, David, Mary.

cases.input: Are there any emails from client-abc?
cases.expected_output: Yes, you received an email from support@client-abc.com yesterday regarding API access.
retrieval_context: Email from support@client-abc.com: Requesting API token and credential setups.

cases.input: Search the wiki for code guidelines
cases.expected_output: I found a wiki page titled 'Code Styling and Linting Guidelines' last updated by David.
retrieval_context: Wiki document: Code Styling Guidelines including eslint and prettier configurations.

cases.input: Who is in charge of marketing?
cases.expected_output: Sarah Connor is the head of the Marketing department.
retrieval_context: Department list: Marketing is led by Sarah Connor.

cases.input: What tasks are assigned to me?
cases.expected_output: You have 3 active tasks assigned to you: Implement G-Eval, Fix CORS issues, and Create seed data.
retrieval_context: Tasks list database contains items assigned to current user, filtering out completed tasks.

cases.input: Find any files related to Q3 budget
cases.expected_output: I found the file 'Q3_Budget_Draft.pdf' in the shared document drive.
retrieval_context: File manager database indexes files by tags and titles including 'Q3', 'budget'.

cases.input: Who sent the email about API design?
cases.expected_output: The email about API design was sent by Alex Vance.
retrieval_context: Email subject: 'Refined API Design Proposals', sender: Alex Vance.

cases.input: Show me recent chat history with Sarah
cases.expected_output: Here is your recent chat with Sarah: [Chat messages where Sarah asks about meeting time and you reply 2 PM]
retrieval_context: Direct message channel history between current user and Sarah Connor.

cases.input: Find a wiki page about security policy
cases.expected_output: I found the wiki page 'Workspace Security Policy and Best Practices' under Guidelines.
retrieval_context: Wiki directory contains a category for Policies containing Security Policy page.

cases.input: What is the phone number of John Doe?
cases.expected_output: John Doe's phone number is +1-555-0199.
retrieval_context: Contact card for John Doe shows phone number as +1-555-0199.

cases.input: Give me a summary of tasks due this Friday
cases.expected_output: Here is the summary of tasks due this Friday: 1. Deploy Auth service. 2. Finish evaluation report.
retrieval_context: Task database query filtering for tasks with due date matching upcoming Friday.
